# 100.00 USD leaving the bank against a receipt of fund units.
#
# The bill side of the same shape. `Assets:Fund` is a Mutual Fund account
# holding FUNDX, and the units are what came back — not money waiting to be
# identified as the settlement of a bill.
#
# A bill posts the other way round, so its settlement is the opposite sign,
# and the sign guard is satisfied here exactly as the invoice fixture's is.
# What refuses it is the commodity, on this side as on that.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, bank −100.00 against
# `Assets:Fund` +1.000 FUNDX valued 100.00, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 commodity FUNDX
	mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	fullname: "Example Balanced Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets:Fund
	type: Mutual Fund
	commodity.namespace: "FUND"
	commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-03-22 * "Bill settled in fund units"
	guid: "1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Fund 1.000 FUNDX
		guid: "3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
		share_price: "100"
		value: "100.00"
